target_customer: OEMs, distributors and VARs selling to US federal and SLED government
problem: Government contractors find it hard to track and win public-sector opportunities; fragmented data (starting with SAM.gov).
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription market network and data

founders.name: Michael Weiland
founders.background_notes: 15 years in government contracting, $2.5B in government sales (YC page).

founders.name: Jon Wright
founders.background_notes: Rose from customer service to VP of Sales in federal IT (YC page).

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and enriching procurement feeds; standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Network of OEMs and resellers sharing deals could lock in; not evidenced beyond the site.

market_need_then: No dated evidence of demand was gathered; the YC page describes federal opportunities as fragmented, starting with SAM.gov feeds.

brand_strength.rationale: Site shows 4.9/5 on G2 (87+ reviews, vendor-reported) but no brand-specific evidence.

outcome_analysis: Govly, YC S21, is Active at Growth stage with about 30 people, founders with deep government sales experience, 200+ claimed customers including Cisco and HPE, and a Govly 2.0 agents launch. No funding or competitor data was retrieved, so the scale of success is unquantified.
notes: Customer count is vendor-reported. Funding not found.
